summary: The shot has a visible ceiling render flicker in the low-angle frames, plus a stiff, tiny subject in a framing that doesn't match the close-up idea. The cut itself and the arm swing are fine.

faults.what: The ceiling, a large part of the frame, flickers between tiles. The pink/gold trim and the white sawtooth-edged panel swap with the dark brown ceiling (82.79 to 83.03). The panel edges are jagged and shift position every frame.
faults.fix: Fix the ceiling mesh, z-fighting or overlapping ceiling layers, or hide or cull the ceiling geometry for this camera.

faults.what: The ceiling flickers again. Jagged white and gold-striped fragments appear and vanish across the brown ceiling at 83.29, 83.36, 83.39 and 83.49, then go dark at 83.53.
faults.fix: Same ceiling fix. Remove the overlapping ceiling planes or the coplanar surfaces.

faults.what: The shot idea is a close-up down the lens from a table top, but the frames show a distant low-angle full-body view. The figure is tiny and the ceiling takes up much of the frame, so the 'he means this' intent is lost.
faults.fix: Move the camera closer and frame him from chest up, with the ceiling out of shot.

faults.what: His arms stay mirrored and symmetrical, both hands near the hips or chest, with a stiff stance. The line of action is weak and the hands read as twinned.
faults.fix: Offset the arms and give one hand a clear gesture, with a hip shift.
